correctness.rationale: Every 4-distinct-coordinate support translates to 0 plus three binary differences of rank two or three, producing respectively the four (1,x,y,xy) types or the eight (1,x,y,z) cube vertices with equal multiplicities. The first set spans iff all four types occur. In the cube, every deficient set has at most four vertex types, and the only deficient four-subsets are its 6 coordinate faces and 6 diagonal planes; all 5-sets span. Inclusion-exclusion over occupied types proves P0=4(3/4)^m-6(1/2)^m+4(1/4)^m and P1=12(1/2)^m+8(3/8)^m-68(1/4)^m+72(1/8)^m, and hypergeometric replacements C(jN/v,m)/C(N,m). Max deficient row counts are 3N/4 and N/2 exactly. Rank is invariant under nonzero column signs and rescaling. Direct rational matrix calculations and occupancy tests independently passed 590 cases, including sharp finite thresholds; all-d,m quantifiers follow from proof not tests.
